hero_title: Akwaaba. Come and worship with us.
hero_text: The Irish-Ghanaian Adventist Community is a family of believers keeping the Sabbath together across the island of Ireland. Whether you have worshipped in an Adventist church all your life or you are simply curious, there is a seat for you this Sabbath.

pillars.title: Worship
pillars.text: Sabbath School, Divine Service and Friday vespers — in English and in Twi, with the hymns and the harmonies we grew up on.

pillars.title: Fellowship
pillars.text: A Ghanaian family far from home. We eat together after service, we pray for each other in the week, and nobody worships alone here.

pillars.title: Service
pillars.text: Health ministry, community outreach, and practical help for members finding their feet in Ireland — faith that shows up on a Tuesday.

quote: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.
